title: IDF says central Gaza ground operation completed; eyewitnesses dispute account
detail: The Israeli military said the tank-backed ground operation near Al-Bureij and Nuseirat that began Nov 18 had ended and COGAT said Palestinians could again move freely in the area. Eyewitnesses disputed the account, saying roads remained closed and that troops had bulldozed homes, industrial facilities and farmland.

media.caption: Israel army says completed central Gaza ground operation

confidenceReason: IDF statement carried by two outlets; damage claims from eyewitnesses
